newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker soars on crude gains, Iraqi news.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker soars on crude gains, Iraqi news.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes on Tuesday soared by around $9 per tonne from Monday amid crude gains driven by escalating tension between Iraq and the United States, brokers said.
Bunker 180 cst was quoted between $120-$125 per tonne, and 380-cst at $115-$120, said traders.

Prices were expected to rise higher nearer the end of the day when cargo prices climb, tracking the gains in crude, traders said. Most shipowners were sidelined although one was cornered to purchase its supplies despite the high prices.
MDO was steady quoted at $190-$198 and gas oil at $205-$206. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
